Frequently Asked Questions

What is the difference between DIN88 and DIN100?

DIN100 (model 60038) has higher capacity (100Ah) and CCA (870A EN) than DIN88 (88Ah, 800A EN). DIN100 is physically longer (393mm vs 353mm).

Does DIN use a different CCA test than JIS/BCI?

Yes. DIN/EN cold-cranking ratings (EN amperes) differ from SAE CCA. Values are not directly interchangeable — compare within the same standard.

Is EFB or AGM available for DIN truck batteries?

Yes. DIN heavy-duty models are available in flooded, EFB and AGM technologies depending on duty cycle and vibration requirements.
